w07-r1.note: Run 1 (scheduled), Week 7. Full-model judgment on top of scripted arithmetic. Method: team kick returns = 0.4 x own avg + 0.4 x opponent kick returns allowed + 0.2 x league avg (4.17), scaled by (1 + 0.5 x (opponent implied pts/22.3 - 1)); team punt returns = same blend (league 1.63); player share set by judgment from last game, pooled 3 games, both depth charts, his chart and injuries; yards per return = 75% player (shrunk to league 25.8 KR / 10.3 PR) + 25% opponent allowed; TD chance per return 0.5% KR / 0.8% PR (league 2026: 0 KR TD in 776, 1 PR TD in 303) times 1.0-1.8 for explosive returners; availability factor 0.9 for Shaheed and C. Jones (limited Wed). Data not available: Thursday practice reports (Wednesday data only), DAL/PHI injury reports (Monday game), kicker-direction data, team-beat news (web search mostly returned 2025 pages), Reddit. No game has kicked off, so nothing carried. His Week 6 table used (postedAt 2026-10-22T11:10Z). DAL Turpin (ribs) expected out, so Goodson not in top 15 on kick volume (6.8 pts, 16th). NYJ Nwangwu Q, Isaiah Williams 5.2 pts (30th). Near-misses: Goodson DAL 6.8, McGowan IND 6.5, Corley CLE 6.5.
